rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically connecting or putting things together.

example.english: Help me join these two wires.
example.traditional: 你幫我接埋呢兩條電線。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 zip3 maai4 ni1 loeng5 tiu4 din6 sin3

rows.note: Use this construction when you go with someone and do the activity together.

example.english: I’ll join Ming to go see a movie.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this for entering a group, club, organization, or shared cause.

example.english: I want to join your book club.
example.traditional: 我想加入你哋個讀書會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 gaa1 jap6 nei5 dei6 go3 duk6 syu1 wui2

rows.note: Use this when joining specifically means marrying.

example.english: They’ll join their lives in marriage next year.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 haa6 nin4 git3 fan1
